---
# OADP S3 backup lab - shared catalog configuration
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster
ocp4_workload_oadp_install: true
oadp_s3_bucket: pstg-oadp-restore-drill-41
oadp_s3_region: ca-central-1
oadp_credentials_secret_name: cloud-credentials-oadp
oadp_s3_access_key_id: <REDACTED>
oadp_s3_secret_access_key: <REDACTED>
oadp_backup_schedule: "0 3 * * *"
oadp_backup_ttl: 720h

---
# prod stage overrides

    scm_ref: ocp4-oadp-s3-backup-1.4.0
